title: "CHORD"
execute:
  echo: false
html-table-processing: none

```{r}
#| label: setup
source(here::here("_setup.R"))
tool <- "chord"
dat$data <- dat$data |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl(tool, .data$tool_parser))
```

## Prediction

```{r}
#| label: chord_prediction
tbl_nm <- "chord_prediction"
d <- dat$data |>
  tw_utils$unnest_data(tbl_nm, schemas_all = dat$schemas)
d$res |>
  tw_table$reactable_wrapdown(
    descriptions = d$schema$schema[c("field", "description")],
    id = tbl_nm
  )
```

## Signatures

```{r}
#| label: chord_signatures
tbl_nm <- "chord_signatures"
d <- dat$data |>
  tw_utils$unnest_data(tbl_nm, schemas_all = dat$schemas)
d$res |>
  tw_table$reactable_wrapdown(
    descriptions = d$schema$schema[c("field", "description")],
    id = tbl_nm,
    pagination = TRUE
  )
```
